text: Men waɗanii kala yimɓe diina sari'a, hiɓe gollira sari'a maɓɓe on, wata pooɗondir e maaɗa -an Nulaaɗo- sirkooɓe ɓen e yimɓe diinaaji goo fii sari'a maaɗa on, ko an ɓuri hanndude e Goonga kan diini kamɓe; sabu kamɓe ko ɓe yimɓe meere, noddu yimɓe ɓen e laɓɓinanngol Alla ngootiigu ngun, pellet, an hiɗa e Laawol Focciingol, ooñannde alaa e maggol.
